article_asking_for_help.summary: Asking for help is a skill, not a weakness. After reading this, you can try first, ask clearly, say what kind of help you need, and tell a grown-up straight away when something is really wrong.
article_asking_for_help.title: How to Ask for Help

article_pump_electrical_safety.summary: A pump moves water, and a pump that moves water can also move current. After reading this article you can name the parts of a pump installation, explain where the leakage comes from, say how current reaches a person through wet ground, compare the six protections that guard the circuit, run a safe check on a pump, and give the right instructions in the first minutes after a shock.
article_pump_electrical_safety.title: Water Pumps and the Risk of Electric Leakage

article_sleep.summary: Sleep is not lost time. It is when your body repairs, consolidates memory and regulates mood. After reading this you can judge whether you are actually getting enough, understand what your sleep cycle does, remove the habits that quietly break your nights, build a wind-down routine that fits a real week, and know when poor sleep needs a doctor.
article_sleep.title: Why Sleep Matters More Than You Think
